definition.def: If one thing merges with another, or is merged with another, they combine or come together to make one whole thing. You can also say that two things merge, or are merged.
examples: My life merged with his. [VERB with noun]
The company had merged with its rival the previous December. [VERB + with]
The rivers merge just north of a vital irrigation system. [VERB]
The two countries merged into one. [VERB + into]
He sees sense in merging the two agencies while both are new. [VERB noun]
Then he showed me how to merge the graphic with text on the same screen. [VERB noun + with]

definition.def: If one sound, colour, or object merges into another, the first changes so gradually into the second that you do not notice the change.
examples: Like a chameleon, he could merge unobtrusively into the background. [VERB + into]
His features merged with the darkness. [VERB + with]
Night and day begin to merge. [VERB]

examples.sentence: Thus, for example, the actor Humphrey Bogart is the character Sam Spade; film personality and life personality seem to merge.
Um. And you spin the wheel around, and if you can get it spinning fast enough, hopefully the colors all merge and show up as white.
